recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度增加，腫瘤細胞核圓形或腎形、彼此被清亮細胞質隔開，呈「荷包蛋」（fried-egg）樣外觀，正常造血細胞明顯減少，是毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）的典型骨髓切片。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a diffuse interstitial infiltrate replacing normal hematopoiesis
Small to medium cells with round, oval or reniform nuclei and bland chromatin
Abundant clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders keeping nuclei widely spaced ('fried-egg' appearance)
Inconspicuous nucleoli and absent mitotic activity
Scattered extravasated red cells; residual hematopoietic elements markedly reduced
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate that effaces much of the normal hematopoietic tissue. At high power the infiltrate consists of small to medium-sized cells with round to reniform nuclei, bland chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, separated by abundant clear cytoplasm with well-defined cell borders, imparting a 'fried-egg' appearance. Extravasated red cells are present in the background, and mitoses are not evident. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; reticulin stain and immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, TRAP, cyclin D1, BRAF V600E) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mast cell lesions form paratrabecular/perivascular aggregates of spindled cells with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are CD117/tryptase positive and CD20 negative.
SMZL cells have scant cytoplasm and form nodular or intrasinusoidal infiltrates rather than widely spaced fried-egg cells, and are annexin A1 negative.
Hypocellular marrows lack a monotonous infiltrate of CD20+ B cells and do not show the fried-egg spacing pattern.
HCL-v shows more intrasinusoidal involvement and cells with prominent nucleoli, and is annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.
